profile.headline: Engineering Leader
profile.summary: I have a proven record of delivering innovative products at a startup pace, leading and building teams that work across functional organizations, and possess deep technical knowledge in security, cloud computing, networking, education and UI/UX.

positions.title: Senior Technical Lead
positions.description: - Helped delivered the network visibility portion of Cisco DNA Center

positions.title: Founder and CEO
positions.description:
WhizKidz Computer Center offers the largest selection of high tech classes for kids ages 5 to 18.  Classes and private 1:1 are offered year round.  We are based in the heart of Silicon Valley, but our classes are online so anyone can sign up.  We have 1-year curriculum for many subjects such as Java, Python, PHP, HTML/CSS/JavaScript and Scratch.  We also have specialized series in machine learning, enterprise Java, Android development, Raspberry Pi, Arduino, LEGO robotics, VEX robotics, Roblox Studio, Minecraft modding, Unity, gaming courses in Python and JavaScript, USACO contests, HackerRank, and AP Computer Science A preparation.

If you are interested in teaching or joining our growing team in other areas, send your resume to jobs@whizkidzcc.com.

Try our two awesome platforms!
https://codepad.app - A new way of coding online!
https://epicmc.rocks - Learn coding with Minecraft

positions.title: Director of Engineering
positions.description: - Managed and developed the web application to configure and monitor virtual networks that use VXLAN overlay technologies. The application worked alongside with OpenStack.

positions.title: Director of Management Software
positions.description:
- Initially designed, architected and implemented an enterprise web-based management platform and later built a team to deliver the first release in 7 months
- Created an overall management plan, strategy and vision including integration with our existing optical products
- Implemented the Agile process within the company and led as the ScrumMaster

positions.title: Sr. Software Development Manager
positions.description:
- Created, led and delivered the next-generation multi-device web-based firewall management application
- Managed and led the team that built three security management projects for the firewall and IPS
- Received the highest 360 feedback within my organization with 100% approval in every category in my last manager rating
- Received three patents in the networking and security area

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Designed and developed a Windows-based application to configure a network of Cisco routers, switches, and hubs
- Designed and developed a Java applet to configure and monitor quality of service (QoS) on Cisco routers
- Designed and developed a Java Web Start application to configure, monitor and troubleshoot Cisco security appliances and modules

positions.title: Staff Engineer
positions.description: - Developed a client-server application to administer a network of PBX'es and voicemail systems

educations.schoolName: California Polytechnic State University-San Luis Obispo
